 THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 -2-  NC: 2024:KHC-K:533  MFA No. 202223 of 2018  JUDGMENT
This is an appeal filed by the Insurance Company questioning the liability.

02. When the matter came up for hearing, the learned counsel for the respondents - claimants submits that the claimants have also filed MFA.No.200201/2019 seeking the enhancement of the compensation and the award was passed on 12.03.2022 whereby a Joint Memo was filed wherein both the parties have agreed to receive a global compensation of an amount of Rs.2,00,000/-.
It is submitted that when a Joint Memo is filed and the matter is settled before the Lok-Adalath, the insurance company cannot maintain this appeal.
03. On the other hand, the learned counsel appearing for the insurance company submits that the Vakalat in the claimants appeal is filed by some other advocate and this appeal is filed by him.
Before the Lok- Adalath the aspect of filing the appeal was not in the NC: 2024:KHC-K:533 knowledge of the insurance company and the insurance company has filed a memo before the Lok-Adalth.
Hence, it is submitted that the insurance company may be permitted to proceed with appeal on the merits under these circumstances.

04. In the appeal filed by the claimants for enhancement whatever are the circumstances, when an award is passed by the Lok-Adalath basing on the Joint Memo filed by both the parties, now it is not open for the insurance company to come up with this kind of plea.
If this plea is accepted, the same thing will crop up in all the cases where the appeals were compromised before the Lok-Adalath.

05. In that view of the matter, the appeal filed by the insurance company is dismissed, in the light of the award passed by the Lok-Adalath in respect of the claimants appeal for enhancement of the compensation i.e., in MFA.No.200201/2019 dated 12.03.2022.
NC: 2024:KHC-K:533 06.
Amount in deposit shall be forthwith transmitted to the Tribunal.

Sd/-
